title: Name the Missing Result Before You Upgrade Anything
excerpt: A new camera body feels like the obvious fix, but most of the results photographers chase, softer backgrounds, sharper files, cleaner low-light shots, come from the lens. Before you spend anything, name the result that is missing.

title: A Chaotic Street Is Not the Problem. The Frame Is.
excerpt: Shibuya Crossing, Leicester Square, a packed market: hundreds of people and signs that refuse to arrange themselves into a photograph. Street photographer Roman Fox pulls clean frames out of that noise with height, subtraction, and patience.

title: Do Not Let a Camera That Does Not Exist Disappoint You
excerpt: The rumor mill promised Panasonic's new cinema camera an unprecedented sensor, 8K, and a global shutter. The real SHX1 is an S1II rebuilt for video professionals, and it is fine. The disappointment was manufactured by the speculation, not the camera.
